title: Snoring (Meme)
blurb: Deep, theatrical, and communicating exactly one message: this has become unbearable. The meme snore is a performance rather than a sound, since nobody asleep has ever snored with that much intention, and it therefore works as a review. Play it during long stories with no visible destination, during meetings that could have been emails, during anybody explaining their fantasy football league to a person who did not ask. It is the polite-society version of standing up and walking out. The snorer is asleep. The message is wide awake.
origin: The theatrical bored-snore of meme culture.
